function: Channel estimation from few pilots using a pre-trained diffusion model as generative prior with posterior sampling; extended to low-resolution ADCs and noisy training data (p. 2, 4).
system: Narrowband point-to-point MIMO, fully digital ULAs, Nt = 64 BS and Nr = 16 user antennas, 40 GHz, QPSK pilots, full-resolution and few-bit ADCs; no RIS (p. 3, 8).
method: Score-based diffusion model with lightweight CNN denoiser, trained as generative prior on channel samples, not supervised on pilots; posterior-sampling inference; SURE-DM variant learns from noisy channels (p. 4, 7).
data_channel: QuaDRiGa simulator, 3GPP 38.901 urban macro LOS scenario at 40 GHz; 100,000 training channels, 100 validation, 100 test channels at new user locations (p. 7-8).
test_conditions: Trained on LOS channels; tested on held-out LOS locations and on NLOS without retraining (Fig. 7); sweeps over SNR, pilot density, ADC bits; noisy-data training (p. 8, 10).
baselines: Non-learned: LMMSE, BLMMSE, LASSO, EM-GM-AMP. Learned: LDAMP, VAE, SGM; the diffusion estimator of [26] only at alpha = 1 (p. 8-9).
metrics: NMSE, online estimation latency, and end-to-end BER with rate-1/2 LDPC code and 64-QAM (p. 8-9, 11).
complexity: FLOPs, latency, parameters in Table I: 5.5G and 22.4G FLOPs, 4.17 and 10 ms, 5.50e4 parameters, for (Nr, Nt) = (16, 64) and (32, 128) (p. 12).
openness: none; GitHub footnotes 7-9 point to code of the LDAMP, VAE and SGM baselines only (p. 8).
q1_support: p. 7: "We adopt the QuaDRiGa toolbox [49] as the channel simulator to generate training, testing, and validation data"; p. 8: "urban macro-cell line-of-sight (LOS) scenario according to the 3rd generation partnership project (3GPP) 38.901 technical report"
q2_support: p. 10: "we deploy the DM trained using LOS channel samples in a non-line-of-sight (NLOS) scenario (with other configurations remaining unchanged) for channel estimation without any retraining or adaptation"
q3_support: p. 8: "LMMSE: Linear estimator using the sample covariance"; "LDAMP: A supervised DL-based channel estimator"; "SGM: The SGM-based estimator from [25]"; p. 9: "outperforms all the compared schemes by a wide margin in estimation accuracy except for the high-complexity SGM"
q4_support: p. 12: "The metrics we evaluate include the inference floating point operations (FLOPs) count, the latency, and the number of parameters in the model"
q5_support: p. 8: "We use the implementation from the publicly available code" refers to the LDAMP baseline; footnotes 7-9 link only baseline code. No link to code or data of the proposed method, and the channels are self-generated with QuaDRiGa (p. 7).
notes: Included, area 2 (channel estimation); Nt = 64 and Nr = 16, so the single-antenna exclusion does not apply. The end-to-end BER of Fig. 12 (p. 11) only evaluates the estimator. q1: QuaDRiGa with the 3GPP 38.901 urban macro LOS scenario (p. 7-8). q2: the LOS-trained model is tested on NLOS without retraining (p. 10, Fig. 7); the SNR, pilot-density and ADC sweeps and the held-out user locations were not counted. q4: Table I on p. 12 gives FLOPs, latency and parameters for the proposed method. q5: QuaDRiGa is a public simulator but the generated dataset is not released.
